description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Nokia, you'll be at the forefront of our software development efforts. Your expertise in Go development and distributed systems will be crucial in designing and implementing robust software solutions. You'll collaborate with a talented team, leveraging your skills in API design and Kubernetes internals to create high-performance, scalable systems. This role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact on our technology stack and drive innovation within the company.
 

 Design and development of a massively distributed edge compute platform, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

 Utilize Kubernetes internals for resource management and container deployment.

 Design and implement software microservices for scale, performance, and security.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality, maintainable code.

 Conduct thorough code reviews, providing constructive feedback to enhance code quality and maintainability.
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues, employing your expertise in distributed systems and high-throughput networking.
 Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, contributing to the team's knowledge and innovation.
 Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
 Participate in project planning and estimation, providing accurate timelines and resource allocation strategies.
 Ensure software solutions meet performance, security, and scalability standards through rigorous testing and optimization.
 Document and maintain comprehensive software documentation, ensuring clear and accessible records for future reference.
 Actively contribute to the team's success by sharing your expertise and collaborating effectively with colleagues.

 
 
 Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with a strong academic background.
 4+ years of experience in software development, with a proven track record in Go development and distributed systems. 
 Proficiency in software design patterns and best practices, with a focus on creating clean, modular, and scalable code.
 Expertise in API design, versioning, and customer portal interactions, ensuring seamless integration and user experience.
 In-depth understanding  and experience with  Kubernetes internals, including resource management, deployment strategies, and containerization.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to tackle complex software challenges.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, fostering effective teamwork and knowledge sharing.
 Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and their integration with software solutions.

 Experience with agile development methodologies and a track record of working in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
 A passion for software development and a commitment to staying updated with industry trends and emerging technologies.
 GitHub profile must show contributions to open-source projects 
 Experience with frontend development (Typescript / React) a plus. 
 
 
 Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 


 
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.  



 
 Learn more about life at Nokia .


 
 



 
 



 
 Our recruitment process 

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.  Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
